blocks.zh: 73 兒童與青少年急性淋巴性白血病 — Christina Peters、Franco Locatelli、Peter Bader

blocks.en:
73.1 Introduction
Acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL) is the most common paediatric cancer; approximately 60% of ALL cases occur in children and adolescents younger than 20 years (Inaba and Pui 2021). Allogeneic haematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) became the most commonly applied cellular immunotherapy and the standard of care for children with ALL who are either at high risk for relapse or had previously experienced a disease recurrence. HCT represents a successful therapeutic option and a relevant proportion of patients achieved long-term survival (Balduzzi et al. 2019). The most frequent cause of treatment failure is relapse after allogeneic HCT. The risk of post-transplant relapse is influenced by several factors, including remission status at transplantation, conditioning regimen and donor type (Peters, et al. 2021). Strategies aimed at reducing the risk of treatment failure have included a reduction of minimal residual disease (MRD) pre-transplant (Bader et al. 2019), the substitution of toxic chemotherapy before transplantation with bispecific antibodies (Locatelli et al. 2021), replacement of HCT with chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy (Maude et al. 2018a, b), improved transplant strategies for specific groups, including infants (Pieters et al. 2019), adolescents and young adults (AYA) (Diesch-Furlanetto et al. 2021) and innovative prophylaxis and treatments for acute and chronic graft-vs.-host disease (GvHD). Furthermore, therapeutic drug monitoring with dose adjustment of some drugs, including busulfan (Diesch-Furlanetto et al. 2021) and novel radiation techniques might enable a more individualised approach (Hoeben et al. 2021).
blocks.zh:
73.1 前言
急性淋巴性白血病（ALL）是最常見的兒童癌症；約 60% 的 ALL 病例發生於 20 歲以下的兒童與青少年（Inaba and Pui 2021）。異體造血細胞移植（HCT）已成為最常應用的細胞免疫療法，也是具有高復發風險或曾發生疾病復發之 ALL 兒童的標準照護。HCT 是一項成功的治療選擇，且相當比例的病患可達到長期存活（Balduzzi et al. 2019）。治療失敗最常見的原因是異體 HCT 後復發。移植後復發的風險受多項因素影響，包括移植時的緩解狀態、調理方案（conditioning regimen）以及供者類型（Peters, et al. 2021）。旨在降低治療失敗風險的策略包括：在移植前降低微量殘存疾病（MRD）（Bader et al. 2019）、以雙特異性抗體取代移植前的高毒性化療（Locatelli et al. 2021）、以嵌合抗原受體（CAR）T 細胞療法取代 HCT（Maude et al. 2018a, b）、針對特定族群（包括嬰兒〔Pieters et al. 2019〕、青少年與年輕成人〔AYA〕〔Diesch-Furlanetto et al. 2021〕）改良移植策略，以及針對急性與慢性移植物抗宿主疾病（GvHD）採取創新的預防與治療。此外，對部分藥物（包括 busulfan）進行治療藥物濃度監測與劑量調整（Diesch-Furlanetto et al. 2021），以及採用新型放射線技術，皆可能使治療方式更為個別化（Hoeben et al. 2021）。

blocks.en:
73.2 Prognostic Factors and Indications for HCT
HCT indications have to be defined prospectively and must be re-evaluated and regularly revised at intervals dependent on modifications and improvements in non-transplant approaches for both front-line and relapse protocols. Some risk factors such as recurrent molecular lesions predicting a poor outcome conveying a dismal prognosis in childhood ALL can be identified at diagnosis (Moorman 2016; O'Connor et al. 2018). In addition, the response to induction therapy measured by MRD levels has a strong prognostic value and now defines many indications for HCT (Bader et al. 2009; Conter et al. 2010; Schrappe et al. 2011; Eckert et al. 2013; Berry et al. 2017).
blocks.zh:
73.2 預後因子與 HCT 適應症
HCT 適應症必須前瞻性地予以定義，並須依據第一線與復發治療方案中非移植療法的修改與進展，定期重新評估與修訂。部分風險因子（例如在兒童 ALL 中預示結果不良、帶來極差預後的反覆出現之分子病灶）可在診斷時即被辨識出來（Moorman 2016; O'Connor et al. 2018）。此外，以 MRD 數值衡量的誘導治療反應具有極強的預後價值，且目前已決定了許多 HCT 的適應症（Bader et al. 2009; Conter et al. 2010; Schrappe et al. 2011; Eckert et al. 2013; Berry et al. 2017）。

blocks.en:
73.2.1 Indications: CR1
Only patients with high-risk cytogenetic features or unsatisfactory response to chemotherapy are eligible for HCT in first remission. In contrast to earlier recommendations, for these patients an MSD and an MUD and for the highest relapse category also mismatched donors (MMD) are an option (Truong et al. 2021). In the ongoing AIEOP-BFM 2017-trial, the very-high-risk subgroup with an indication for HCT in first CR is defined by
1. The presence of TCF3-HLF gene fusion,
2. KMT2A-AFF1 gene fusion,
3. Hypodiploidy defined as <44 chromosmes,
4. IKZF1plus deletions and medium-risk/high-risk MRD levels at the end of consolidation,
5. PCR-MRD HR, and.
6. T-ALL with PPR and/or FCM-MRD d15 HR and/or IF.
blocks.zh:
73.2.1 適應症：CR1
僅有具備高風險細胞遺傳學特徵或對化療反應不佳的病患，才符合在第一次緩解時接受 HCT 的資格。與早期的建議不同，對這些病患而言，HLA 相合手足供者（MSD）與相合非親屬供者（MUD）皆為可選方案，且針對最高復發風險類別，HLA 不相合供者（MMD）亦為選項之一（Truong et al. 2021）。在進行中的 AIEOP-BFM 2017 臨床試驗中，具有第一次 CR 接受 HCT 適應症的極高風險（very-high-risk）次族群定義如下：
1. 存在 TCF3-HLF 基因融合，
2. KMT2A-AFF1 基因融合，
3. 低二倍體（hypodiploidy），定義為染色體少於 44 條（<44 chromosomes），
4. IKZF1plus 缺失，且在鞏固治療結束時具有中度風險／高風險 MRD 數值，
5. PCR-MRD 高風險（HR），以及
6. T 細胞急性淋巴性白血病（T-ALL）合併 prednisone 反應不佳（PPR）及／或第 15 天流式細胞儀 MRD（FCM-MRD d15）高風險（HR）及／或誘導失敗（IF）。

blocks.en: Patients with MRD negativity at EOI are excluded from a HCT indication. MMD-HCTs are nowadays reserved for a PCR-MRD TP2 ≥ 5 × 10⁻³, all TCF3-HLF fused leukaemias and those with induction failure (Table 73.1).
blocks.zh: 在誘導治療結束時（EOI）達到 MRD 陰性的病患，排除於 HCT 適應症之外。如今，MMD-HCT 僅保留給第 2 時間點 PCR-MRD（PCR-MRD TP2）≥ 5 × 10⁻³、所有具有 TCF3-HLF 融合的白血病，以及誘導失敗的病患（表 73.1）。

blocks.en:
73.2.2 Indications: CR2 and Later
All patients with relapse of T-ALL and patients with B-ALL who relapse during frontline therapy or within 6 months from treatment discontinuation (very early and early relapse) have a dismal prognosis when treated with conventional chemotherapy. Allo-HCT from any donor type is the contemporary standard post-remission consolidation therapy (Table 73.2a).
blocks.zh:
73.2.2 適應症：CR2 及其後
所有 T-ALL 復發的病患，以及在第一線治療期間或停藥後 6 個月內復發（極早期與早期復發）的 B-ALL 病患，若僅接受傳統化療，預後極差。來自任何供者類型的異體 HCT（allo-HCT）是當代標準的緩解後鞏固治療（表 73.2）。

blocks.en: In multiple relapsed patients, if they achieve a third or higher remission, allo-HCT should be considered in all patients, provided that their condition allows such a procedure. Patient not in morphological remission should not be transplanted except in extraordinary experimental situations (e.g. well-designed clinical trial with clear scientific questions).
blocks.zh: 對於多次復發的病患，若能達到第三次或更後線的緩解，只要其身體狀況允許此項處置，所有病患皆應考慮接受異體 HCT。未達形態學緩解的病患，除非處於極特殊的實驗性情境（例如具有明確科學問題且設計良好的臨床試驗），否則不應進行移植。

blocks.en:
73.3 Donor Selection and Stem Cell Source
OS and incidence of NRM in patients transplanted from a MSD as well as from a > 9/10 MUD have steadily improved over time, and today the results for these outcomes do not differ according to the type of donor. However, it has been shown that in children HCT from an HLA-identical sibling results in a faster myeloid engraftment, prompter immunoreconstitution and less severe infections and should remain the preferred option (Peters et al. 2015a, b).
blocks.zh:
73.3 供者選擇與幹細胞來源
接受 MSD 以及 > 9/10 MUD 移植之病患的整體存活率（OS）與非復發死亡率（NRM）發生率已隨時間穩定改善，且如今這些結果並不因供者類型不同而有差異。然而，研究已證實，在兒童中，來自 HLA 相合手足的 HCT 可帶來更快速的骨髓系植入、更及時的免疫重建以及較少的嚴重感染，因此仍應作為首選方案（Peters et al. 2015a, b）。

blocks.en: Since less than 25% of patients have a MSD, HCT from an alternative donors is most frequently applied. Several groups have demonstrated that an HCT from a MUD, identified by HLA high-resolution typing, has a similar outcome as a MSD-HCT (Zhang et al. 2012; Fagioli et al. 2013; Burke et al. 2015) Notably, Dalle et al. recently reported the 3-year consolidated results of 612 patients aged 4–21 years, treated at >100 pediatric centers in 26 countries following HCT from either MSD (n = 186, 30%) or MUD (defined as 9 or 10/10 4-digit molecular HLA compatibility, n = 426, 70%) following 12Gy TBI-VP16 for ALL in CR1. GvHD-relapse-secondary malignancy-free survival (GRFS) was significantly better in MUD vs. MSD (62 ± 3 vs. ±51 ± 5%, P = 0.04) (Dalle et al. 2022).
blocks.zh: 由於僅有不到 25% 的病患擁有 MSD，因此最常採用來自替代供者的 HCT。多個研究團隊已證實，透過 HLA 高解析度定型所選出的 MUD，其 HCT 治療結果與 MSD-HCT 相近（Zhang et al. 2012; Fagioli et al. 2013; Burke et al. 2015）。值得注意的是，Dalle 等人近期報告了 612 名年齡 4–21 歲、在 26 個國家超過 100 家兒科中心接受治療之 CR1 ALL 病患的 3 年整合結果；這些病患在 12 Gy 全身放射線照射併用 etoposide（TBI-VP16）調理後，接受來自 MSD（n = 186，30%）或 MUD（定義為 9/10 或 10/10 四位數分子 HLA 相合，n = 426，70%）的 HCT。無 GvHD、無復發且無次發性惡性腫瘤存活率（GRFS）在 MUD 組顯著優於 MSD 組（62 ± 3% 對 ±51 ± 5%，P = 0.04）（Dalle et al. 2022）。

blocks.en: Several methods were developed to overcome the HLA barriers in those patients who lack an HLA compatible donor. Currently, it is not clear which of the following, HLA-mismatched CB, TCD (alpha-beta depleted, CD34+ selected or CD3/CD19 depleted) haploidentical grafts or PT-CY approaches, will result in the best outcome (Lang and Handgretinger 2008; Smith et al. 2009; Ruggeri et al. 2014; Locatelli et al. 2017; Rocha, et al. 2021) (Tables 73.3 and 73.4). Very promising results have been recently confirmed in children with ALL receinving a graft from an α/β T cell depleted HLA-haploidentical relative, with a very low risk of NRM and of both acute and chronic GvHD (Merli et al. 2022).
blocks.zh: 針對缺乏 HLA 相合供者的病患，目前已發展出多種克服 HLA 屏障的方法。目前尚不清楚下列何種方式能帶來最佳結果：HLA 不相合臍帶血（CB）、去 T 細胞（TCD，包括 α/β T 細胞去除、CD34+ 陽性選殖或 CD3/CD19 去除）半相合移植物，或是移植後 cyclophosphamide（PT-CY）策略（Lang and Handgretinger 2008; Smith et al. 2009; Ruggeri et al. 2014; Locatelli et al. 2017; Rocha, et al. 2021）（表 73.3 與表 73.4）。近期在兒童 ALL 病患中，接受來自 α/β T 細胞去除之 HLA 半相合親屬移植物已證實具有非常令人鼓舞的結果，其 NRM 以及急性與慢性 GvHD 的風險皆極低（Merli et al. 2022）。

blocks.en:
73.4 Conditioning Regimen
A myeloablative conditioning regimen is the treatment of choice for children and AYA with ALL. The FORUM trial demonstrated the significant superiority of the TBI/etoposide scheme in a randomized, prospective, multicenter, phase III trial. At a median age of 4.5 years, patients over 4 years of age with high-risk ALL had a 20% better OS and EFS and a lower NRM compared to patients who received a chemotherapy-based conditioning regimen.(Locatelli et al. 2022). In addition, the risk of leukaemia recurrence was much lower in patients given TBI as part of the conditioning regimen in comparison to those prepared with a chemo-therapy-based myeloablation. The same study showed that a myeloablative regimen containing treosulfan, thiotepa and fludarabine was associated with an outcome comparable to that of patients treated with busulfan, thiotepa and fludarabine (Peters, et al. 2021) (Fig. 73.1).
blocks.zh:
73.4 調理方案
骨髓消除性（myeloablative）調理方案是兒童與 AYA ALL 病患的首選治療。FORUM 試驗在一項隨機、前瞻性、多中心、第三期臨床試驗中，證實了全身放射線照射（TBI）／etoposide 方案的顯著優勢。在中位年齡 4.5 歲的條件下，4 歲以上的高風險 ALL 病患與接受化學治療為基礎之調理方案的病患相比，整體存活率（OS）與無事件存活率（EFS）高出 20%，且非復發死亡率（NRM）較低（Locatelli et al. 2022）。此外，接受包含 TBI 在內之調理方案的病患，其白血病復發風險遠低於接受以化療為基礎之骨髓消除方案準備的病患。同一項研究亦顯示，包含 treosulfan、thiotepa 與 fludarabine 的骨髓消除方案，其治療結果與接受 busulfan、thiotepa 與 fludarabine 治療的病患相當（Peters, et al. 2021）（圖 73.1）。

blocks.en: Whether a myeloablative conditioning with treosulfan will have a more benign adverse event profile and a higher chance for fertility preservation remains to be proven (Wachowiak et al. 2011; Boztug et al. 2015; Lee et al. 2015; Faraci et al. 2019).
blocks.zh: 使用 treosulfan 的骨髓消除性調理是否具有更溫和的不良事件表現以及更高的生育力保存機會，仍有待證實（Wachowiak et al. 2011; Boztug et al. 2015; Lee et al. 2015; Faraci et al. 2019）。

blocks.en: Whenever possible, the interval between the end of the last chemotherapy and the start of the conditioning regimen should be 3–6 weeks to reduce the risk of NRM. If infection or toxicity requires a delay in conditioning, patients receive risk-adjusted chemotherapy or immunotherapy to bridge the time to transplant. The most successful approach to allow a reduction of MRD before transplantation is the use of blinatumomab. The continuous infusion of the bispecific antibody enables not only a deeper remission but also to spare chemotherapy-associated organ toxicity which results in better pre-transplant performance status (Locatelli et al. 2000a, b).
blocks.zh: 只要情況允許，最後一次化療結束至開始調理方案之間的間隔應為 3–6 週，以降低 NRM 風險。若因感染或毒性而必須延後調理，病患應接受依風險調整的化療或免疫治療，以橋接至移植前的等待時間。在移植前降低 MRD 最成功的方法是使用 blinatumomab。連續輸注此雙特異性抗體不僅能達成更深度的緩解，亦能避免化療相關的器官毒性，進而使病患在移植前具有更佳的體能狀態（Locatelli et al. 2000a, b）。

blocks.en:
73.5 GVHD Prophylaxis
Children transplanted with bone marrow from MSD might benefit from an augmented GVL effect if only cyclosporine A is administered as GVHD prophylaxis (Locatelli et al. 2000a, b; Peters et al. 2010). However, careful monitoring and rapid intervention are crucial to prevent the development of severe GVHD. After HCT from non-sibling donors, a combination of a calcineurin inhibitor with short-course MTX and ATG is given in most patients (Peters et al. 2015a, b; Veys et al. 2012a, b; Balduzzi et al. 2019).
blocks.zh:
73.5 GVHD 預防
接受 MSD 骨髓移植的兒童，若僅給予 cyclosporine A 作為 GVHD 預防用藥，可能會因增強的移植物抗白血病（GVL）效應而獲益（Locatelli et al. 2000a, b; Peters et al. 2010）。然而，密切監測與迅速介入對於預防嚴重 GVHD 的發生至關重要。在接受非手足供者 HCT 後，大多數病患會給予鈣調磷酸酶抑制劑（calcineurin inhibitor）併用短療程 methotrexate（MTX）與抗胸腺細胞球蛋白（ATG）的組合方案（Peters et al. 2015a, b; Veys et al. 2012a, b; Balduzzi et al. 2019）。

blocks.en:
73.6 Children below 4 Years of Age
Both relapse and NRM contribute to treatment failure in infants and young children with high-risk ALL undergoing HCT. The optimal chemotherapeutic approach able to improve event-free survival (EFS) and to reduce the risk of NRM is not yet defined (Peters et al. 2022).
blocks.zh:
73.6 4 歲以下兒童
在接受 HCT 的高風險 ALL 嬰兒與幼童中，復發與非復發死亡率（NRM）皆是造成治療失敗的原因。能夠改善無事件存活率（EFS）並降低 NRM 風險的最佳化療調理方式目前尚未確立（Peters et al. 2022）。

blocks.en:
73.6.1 Mixed Chimerism (MC) and MRD
Mixed chimerism (MC) and MRD strongly predict risk for relapse in children (Bader et al. 2015).
blocks.zh:
73.6.1 混合嵌合狀態（MC）與 MRD
混合嵌合狀態（MC）與 MRD 強烈預測兒童的復發風險（Bader et al. 2015）。

blocks.en: Preemptive immunotherapy, e.g. withdrawal of IS or DLI guided by chimerism and MRD monitoring, may prevent impending relapse. However, the dynamic of leukaemic reappearance hampers the final success of these methods. Therefore, new post-transplant intervention strategies with less risk for severe complications like bi-specific antibodies or CAR-T-cell interventions may expedite the control of impending relapse (Handgretinger et al. 2011; Maude et al. 2018a, b).
blocks.zh: 在嵌合狀態與 MRD 監測指引下進行搶先性（preemptive）免疫治療（例如停用免疫抑制劑〔IS〕或給予供者淋巴球輸注〔DLI〕），可能防止即將發生的復發。然而，白血病再次出現的快速動態過程限制了這些方法的最終成功率。因此，發生嚴重併發症風險較低的新型移植後介入策略（例如雙特異性抗體或 CAR-T 細胞介入治療），可能會加速控制即將發生的復發（Handgretinger et al. 2011; Maude et al. 2018a, b）。

blocks.en:
73.6.2.1 The Amended EsPhALL Recommendation
Administration of imatinib prophylaxis post HCT when more than 50,000 platelets are reached is recommended with a duration of 365 days after HCT.
blocks.zh:
73.6.2.1 修訂版 EsPhALL 建議
建議在 HCT 後血小板數回升超過 50,000 時開始給予 imatinib 預防治療，持續時間為 HCT 後 365 天。

blocks.en:
73.6.2.2 TKI According to MRD Result
Administration of imatinib post HCT for all MRD-positive patients until two negative results are achieved. FACS- and PCR-MRD analyses are accepted.
blocks.zh:
73.6.2.2 依據 MRD 結果給予 TKI
針對所有 MRD 陽性的病患，在 HCT 後給予 imatinib 治療，直到連續達成兩次 MRD 陰性結果為止。流式細胞儀（FACS）與 PCR-MRD 分析方式皆可接受。

blocks.en:
Key Points
• Only children and adolescents with very high or high relapse risk should be candidates for allo-HCT in CR1 and CR2. The assessment of relapse risk is largely influenced by the presence of recurrent molecular and cytogenetic abnormalities, response to chemotherapy, assessed through MRD evaluation and in relapsed patients – by time and site of relapse.
• MRD levels pre- and post-HCT are powerful predictors for outcome after HCT.
• Patients who are not in morphological remission before conditioning should not undergo allogeneic HCT except in extraordinary situations.
• Fractionated TBI/VP16-MAC is recommended for all children above the age of 4 with ALL. If this is not possible, a myeloablative chemo-conditioning is an option.
blocks.zh:
重點摘要（Key Points）
• 僅有具極高或高復發風險的兒童與青少年，才應作為在 CR1 與 CR2 接受異體 HCT（allo-HCT）的候選對象。復發風險的評估主要受下列因素影響：是否存在反覆出現的分子與細胞遺傳學異常、透過 MRD 評估所測得的化療反應，以及在復發病患中的復發時間與復發部位。
• HCT 前與 HCT 後的 MRD 數值是預測 HCT 後治療結果的強力指標。
• 在調理前未達形態學緩解的病患，除非處於極特殊情況，否則不應接受異體 HCT。
• 對於所有 4 歲以上的 ALL 兒童，建議採用分次全身放射線照射併用 etoposide 之骨髓消除性調理（fractionated TBI/VP16-MAC）。若無法實行，則可選擇骨髓消除性化療調理（myeloablative chemo-conditioning）。
